description: This file is a PHP class definition for the `Translation` model within the OpenCart admin design namespace. It provides methods for managing translation records such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving translation data from the database.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: A model class responsible for CRUD operations related to translations within the OpenCart admin design namespace.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Inserts a new translation record into the database with the provided data.

methods.name: editTranslation
methods.description: Updates an existing translation record identified by translation_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteTranslation
methods.description: Deletes a translation record specified by the translation_id.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific translation identified by translation_id.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of translations with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTranslations
methods.description: Returns the total count of translation records in the database.
